title: Final Radius Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the radius ratio R_i/R_f as 10^-3.

title: Decoupling Age Fraction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly conclude that decoupling occurred at 10^-3 of the present age of the universe.

title: Work Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the work done by photons as W = (π^2/15ħ^3c^3)V_iτ_i^3(τ_i - τ_f).

title: Isentropic Process Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the isentropic process and its implications for energy changes.

title: Use of Stefan-Boltzmann Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Stefan-Boltzmann law in the context of internal energy calculations.

title: Volume-Temperature Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate volume and temperature in the context of the expansion.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or misapplication of physical laws.
